extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the browser's extension management page and store listing. Keep the brand name 'Freedium' untranslated.

extensionDescription.message: Læs enhver Medium-artikel på Freedium med et enkelt klik.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension management page and store listing. Keep 'Freedium' and 'Medium' untranslated as brand names.

extensionTitle.description: Toolbar icon tooltip, and the popup/changelog page title. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

versionLabel.description: Label preceding the installed version number in the popup, e.g. 'Version 2.0.0'.

popupBlurb.message: Åbn enhver Medium-artikel på Freedium: klik på den grønne knap på en artikelside, eller Freedium-ikonet på et feed-kort.
popupBlurb.description: Short explanation shown in the toolbar popup. Keep 'Medium' and 'Freedium' untranslated as brand names.

whatsNew.description: Label for the changelog button in the popup, and the changelog page's own title/heading.

contributeGithub.description: Link text in the popup pointing to the project's GitHub repository. Keep 'GitHub' untranslated as a brand name.

privacyPolicy.description: Link text in the popup pointing to the privacy policy document.

privacyShort.description: Short link text in the changelog page footer pointing to the privacy policy document.

socialLinksAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the row of social-media icon links on the changelog page.

footerMeta.description: Copyright line in the changelog page footer. Keep 'Freedium' and the person's name 'Rohan Parmar' untranslated.

subtitleWelcome.message: Tak for installationen! Her er alt, hvad Open in Freedium kan gøre, og hvad der er kommet med i hver udgivelse.
subtitleWelcome.description: Changelog page subtitle shown right after the extension is first installed. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

subtitleDefault.message: Følg med i, hvordan Open in Freedium har udviklet sig. Hver udgivelse nedenfor fremhæver de vigtigste forbedringer, du har fået.
subtitleDefault.description: Changelog page subtitle shown on normal (non-welcome) visits. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

readOnFreedium.description: Label/title for the button that opens the current Medium article on Freedium. Used on both the floating article button and each feed card. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

readArticleAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the floating button on a Medium article page that opens it on Freedium. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

copyFreediumLink.description: Label/title/aria-label for the button that copies the article's Freedium link to the clipboard. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

toastOpening.description: Toast message shown while the article opens on Freedium in a new tab. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

toastLinkCopied.description: Toast message shown after the Freedium link was copied to the clipboard. Keep 'Freedium' untranslated as a brand name.

toastCopyFailed.description: Toast message shown when copying the Freedium link to the clipboard failed.

latest.description: Badge/tag label marking the most recent release on the changelog timeline.

websiteAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the personal website link icon in the changelog page's social links row.
